taskVersion.name: ves-heldout-item

parts.text:
Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station H-05, survey area H. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 26.6 | 4.30 | 4.30
2 | 119.1 | 2.37 | 6.67
3 | 340.4 | 0.77 | 7.44
4 | 640.3 | 0.77 | 8.21
5 | 2441.4 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as AA-type.

Is this label correct for these layer values? Give a short answer, then end with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"label_correct": true or false, "curve_type": "<letters>"}

The layer resistivities are 26.6, 119.1, 340.4, 640.3, and 2441.4. Following the provided rule for a 5-layer model ($N=5$), we need to determine $N-2 = 3$ letters:
1.  **Layers 1-2-3:** $26.6 < 119.1 < 340.4 \implies \mathbf{A}$
2.  **Layers 2-3-4:** $119.1 < 340.4 < 640.3 \implies \mathbf{A}$
3.  **Layers 3-4-5:** $340.4 < 640.3 < 2441.4 \implies \mathbf{A}$

The sequence is **AAA**. According to the rule, "If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A)." The label provided is "AA-type," which is incorrect as it does not follow the $N-2$ rule for 5 layers (which requires 3 letters) nor the simplification rule (which allows for a single letter).

{"label_correct": false, "curve_type": "AAA"}
